concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading datasets from the OpenML Small Datasets collection. Task T011 falls back to UCI datasets and only logs a deviation; this weakens the functional requirement without a spec amendment.

FR-004 mandates recording baseline metrics to `data/processed/baseline_metrics.json`. Task T013 is left unchecked and notes a blocking gap (SC-006), meaning the required artifact may never be produced.
FR-004 also requires cleaned‑dataset metrics (`cleaned_metrics.json`). Task T023 is unchecked, so the artifact is missing, breaking the downstream comparison steps.

FR-006 specifies a sweep over outlier‑threshold values with FPR and inconsistency‑rate reporting. Task T033 (outlier‑threshold sweep) is not implemented (unchecked), leaving the requirement unsatisfied.

FR-007 demands Benjamini‑Hochberg multiple‑comparison correction. Task T028 logs a warning but implements Bonferroni correction, which is a weaker correction method and violates the functional requirement.

FR-008 requires stratification by dataset‑size and missingness bins with at least one dataset per bin. Task T029 only logs a warning for empty bins and does not enforce the ≥1‑per‑bin rule, weakening the requirement.

Constitution Principle VI mandates a minimum of 1 000 bootstrap iterations. Task T045 conditionally reduces iterations to 500 for large datasets, directly violating the constitutional statistical‑sensitivity rule.
FR-011 requires generation of permutation null datasets and estimation of false‑positive rates. Task T032 is unchecked, so the required artifact `null_fpr_metrics.json` will not be produced.

Success Criterion SC‑006 calls for baseline metrics on ≥10 datasets. The current task set only acknowledges the shortfall (blocking gap) and does not add any tasks to acquire additional datasets, leaving the criterion unmet.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires random seeds to be pinned and used throughout the pipeline. Tasks T004‑T006 define seed‑pinning utilities but no task invokes them, risking non‑reproducible runs.
